data.one_liner: A customizable Star Rating Dialog package for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable star rating dialog widget that can be displayed using Flutter's showDialog function. It allows users to submit a star rating and an optional comment.
use_when: You need to ask users for a rating and review inside your app
You want a pre-built dialog with a star rating bar, title, message, and comment input
avoid_when: You need a embedded inline rating widget instead of a dialog
You require complex custom form elements beyond a star rating and text comment
strengths: Customizable appearance including star size and button text
Supports all platforms supported by Flutter
Built-in handling for validation (disables submit when rating is zero)
weaknesses: Relies on showDialog rather than a standalone form widget
